en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a waterfront scene in Stockholm. In the background stands a large rectangular palace building with many windows, and other classical buildings along the quays. Several boats are moored by the shore, while a passenger boat crosses the water in the foreground. Printed text at the top identifies the scene, and the boat bears a readable name on its side.
